# Third-party frontend assets

The browser uses locally served copies so core UI features do not require a CDN.

| Library | Version | License | Local files |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GSAP and ScrollTrigger | 3.15.1 | Standard no charge license | `gsap/gsap.min.js`, `gsap/ScrollTrigger.min.js` |
| Lucide static SVG sprite | 1.80.0 | ISC | `lucide/sprite.svg`, `lucide/LICENSE` |
| Bricolage Grotesque | 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `fonts/bricolage-grotesque-latin-400-normal.woff2` |
| Instrument Sans | 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `fonts/instrument-sans-latin-400-normal.woff2` |
| JetBrains Mono | 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 | `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2` |

Font license texts are included in `fonts/`. GSAP identifies its license in the package metadata and at https://gsap.com/standard-license.
